scope: Rights-attributed real-background source acquisition for H3 identity-topology r4
summary: Six split-assigned Pexels sources were downloaded or copied, hashed, probed, licensed, and storyboarded in one immutable preparation run.
evidence: The completed source manifest SHA-256 is 640a7b8c53f6a62a5a5442f7028e41d4fbc46aec56f80e125186137ef0f0fbd5.
Three sources are assigned to train, one to validation, and two to test; all six media files have source SHA-256, creator, landing URL, license ID, ffprobe output, and a review storyboard.
The source preparation stores media only in ignored experiment outputs and records that adapter distribution still requires combined upstream-model and data-license review.
lessons: Public-media provenance must be frozen before any crop or synthetic-composite transformation.
A licensed real video is not automatically topology-positive training data when people or hands remain visible.
limitations: The sources are research inputs under the Pexels License; this record is not a legal opinion or release authorization.
Source acquisition and storyboards do not establish person-free topology supervision.
next_actions: Use only reviewed person-free ROIs for topology-positive composites and retain source hashes through compilation.
